options.noclip.title: noclip Settings
options.noclip.enabled.tooltip: Whether noclip is active now. The toggle key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.noclip.axis_x.tooltip: Blocks, the world border, and entities that noclip passes through do not stop movement along the X axis (east and west).
options.noclip.axis_y.tooltip: Blocks, the world border, and entities that noclip passes through do not stop movement along the Y axis (up and down). Unless you fly, you fall through the ground.
options.noclip.axis_z.tooltip: Blocks, the world border, and entities that noclip passes through do not stop movement along the Z axis (north and south).
options.noclip.jump_up.tooltip: While you hold the jump key, blocks, the world border, and entities that noclip passes through do not stop you from moving up, even with the Y axis off.
options.noclip.sneak_down.tooltip: While you hold the sneak key, blocks, the world border, and entities that noclip passes through do not stop you from moving down, even with the Y axis off. Unless you fly, you fall through the ground.
options.noclip.blocks.tooltip: Move through blocks along the noclip axes, without being pushed out of them or forced to crouch or crawl inside them. Servers set you back unless they trust your movement, for example with nomovementcheck.
options.noclip.fluids.tooltip: Move through water and lava as if they were air: no drag, currents, buoyancy, swimming, or bubble columns.
options.noclip.world_border.tooltip: Move through the world border along the noclip axes.
options.noclip.slowing_blocks.tooltip: Cobwebs, sweet berry bushes, and powder snow no longer slow you down. Their damage and freezing still apply.
options.noclip.entities.tooltip: Move through solid entities such as boats, minecarts, and shulkers along the noclip axes, and stop pushing nearby entities and being pushed by them. Servers set you back unless they trust your movement, for example with nomovementcheck.
options.noclip.only_while_flying.tooltip: Noclip is only active while you are flying.
options.noclip.clear_view.tooltip: While your head is inside a block, hide the block texture that covers the screen and keep the world around you visible, as in spectator mode.
options.noclip.singleplayer_default.tool: The state of Noclip restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.noclip.multiplayer_default.toolt: The state of Noclip restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.noclip.reset_on_world_exit.toolt: Every world starts from its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.noclip.reset_on_game_exit.toolti: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts from its default state.
options.noclip.multiplayer_mode.warning: Servers with anti-cheat may set you back, kick you, or ban you for using noclip. This mod does not try to bypass any anti-cheat.
options.noclip.multiplayer_mode.whitelis: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.noclip.multiplayer_mode.blacklis: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.noclip.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.noclip.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.noclip: Removes the local player's client-side collisions.
